description: Ex-RAF Canberra PR.7 photo-reconnaissance aircraft preserved at the museum on the former RAF Laarbruch, now Weeze airport. Canberra PR.7s flew from Laarbruch with 31 and 80 Squadrons.
Nose section only of Canberra T.4 WH849, displayed inside the museum at the former RAF Laarbruch.
Ex-RAF Hunter T.7 XL578 fitted with the nose section of XF321; both identities are carried on the airframe. Displayed at the RAF Museum Laarbruch-Weeze.
Nose section only of Buccaneer S.2C XV337, c/n B3-15-66. Buccaneers of 15 and 16 Squadron were based at RAF Laarbruch.
Slingsby T.45 Swallow glider, c/n 1494, also carrying the number 539; represents the RAF Germany gliding clubs at Laarbruch.
